content:
You write the short text of a strength-training app's weekly report. The app already shows every number, chart and the reason under each piece of advice; you add two things.

Period: 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04 (one week, 7 days).
Status, decided by code: progressing (main lifts: 4 up, 1 flat, 0 down).
Sessions: 5 of 6 planned. Sets: 58 (last week 66).
Main lifts, best set this week:
- 槓鈴臥推: 82.5 kg x 8 (last week 82.5 kg x 8), flat (3 weeks without a new best), 8 sets this week
- 槓鈴划船: 70 kg x 8 (last week 67.5 kg x 8), up 3.7%, 8 sets this week
- 深蹲: 100 kg x 6 (last week 97.5 kg x 6), up 2.6%, 4 sets this week
- 肩推: 45 kg x 8 (last week 42.5 kg x 8), up 5.9%, 8 sets this week
- 羅馬尼亞硬舉: 90 kg x 8 (last week 87.5 kg x 8), up 2.9%, 4 sets this week
New records (best estimated 1RM so far; not necessarily a new weight): 槓鈴划船 70 kg x 8; 深蹲 100 kg x 6; 肩推 45 kg x 8; 羅馬尼亞硬舉 90 kg x 8.
Sets per muscle per week (range 10-20 for chest, back, legs, shoulders, glutes): chest 14, shoulders 14, triceps 4, back 14, biceps 4, legs 8.
No body weight logged.
Weights are in kg; write every weight in kg.
The user's goal: "增肌".
The user's note for this week: none.
Last report's advice and how it went (the app shows this; mention it in the headline only if it matters):
- low_volume:back: done
- lift_stalled:ex-bench: not_done
- missed_sessions:-: partial
Rules that fired. Advise only on these, by id:
- id "lift_stalled:ex-bench", priority 60, data {"name":"Barbell Bench Press","nameZh":"槓鈴臥推","best":"82.5 kg x 8","previousBest":"82.5 kg x 8","change":0,"bodyweight":0,"flatWindows":3}. Advice: Double progression: keep the weight and add reps on every set until all sets reach the top of the rep range, then add the smallest jump (2.5 kg upper body, 5 kg lower body).
- id "missed_sessions:-", priority 40, data {"done":5,"planned":6,"missed":1,"routines":"腿日","dates":"2026-10-02","lowGroups":"legs"}. Advice: Name the missed sessions and suggest a realistic way to fit the work in or plan around those days. Never scold; if the note explains it, acknowledge that.

1. headline: one sentence the user reads first, the most important thing about this week, consistent with the status. It may use a number from above. At most 40 characters.
2. items: advice for at most 3 of the fired rules, most important first: usually by priority, but the goal or the note may change the order. A deload, if it fired, is always included and first. Each action is one or two short sentences saying exactly what to do next week, with the exercise, sets, weights or reps from the data. Don't repeat the reason; the app shows it.

Use only the numbers above; never invent data. No myths, no diagnosis, no scolding. Plain text only: no Markdown, no lists inside a field. Write in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文, Taiwan usage) with full-width punctuation (，。！？「」), and use the Chinese exercise names given above.
